description: Is the US government shut down right now? Answers yes or no from the US Office of Personnel Management's current operating status, flagging a lapse in appropriations and telling a partial lapse (only some agencies unfunded) apart from a full one, with OPM's exact wording and when the notice was posted. It reflects OPM's posted status only: it does not forecast funding deadlines, and during a lapse each agency decides which staff keep working. (cost: 1 credit)
name: us_shutdown_now
